title: When the Cover Falls
author: C. M. Hartwell
blurb: Isandro Villalobos, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
